issues: React hydration warning in console: <span> cannot be a child of <option> — emitted by MiraDayOffer.jsx line ~55, MessageCreditsCard.jsx line ~82, ManagersSection.jsx line ~125. Pre-existing (also flagged in iter 160-163) — cosmetic only, no functional impact. Root cause is Emergent Studio's runtime injector wrapping dynamic <option> text in a <span data-ve-dynamic>, which is illegal HTML.

critical_code_review_comments: staff_portal.py:_salon_day_snapshot uses `db.appointments.count_documents({scheduled_at: {$regex: '^<day>'}, status:{$ne:'cancelled'}})` — regex on a non-indexed string field will do a collection scan on busy tenants. Consider storing scheduled_at as ISO date + a scheduled_local_day derived field and indexing it, or using $gte/$lt against parsed datetime.

staff_portal.py:_salon_day_snapshot invoice query filters `status: {$nin:['voided','open']}` — 'open' here likely means 'draft/unpaid'. If a tenant marks paid invoices with a status other than 'paid' (e.g. 'partial'), they will still be included in today's cash/UPI/card totals. Consider explicit whitelist status ∈ ['paid','settled'] instead of blacklist.

BankDetailsIn.account_number uses regex `^[0-9]*$` — accepts empty string. If empty account is set intentionally, that's fine; otherwise consider min_length=1 or require non-empty when bank_name/ifsc are provided.

hq_clear_email_log wipes the entire email_log with `delete_many({})` and no confirmation grace period. Consider a soft-delete flag or a 'clear older than X days' variant so an accidental Clear from Super-Admin UI cannot destroy diagnostic data during an active incident.

PortalBits.jsx SalonKpiStrip masks account is derived client-side from full account_number in bank_details response — the backend GET /api/staff/me/profile returns the full account_number in plaintext. Fine for the staff viewing their own record, but if this endpoint is ever exposed to a peer or manager scope, consider masking server-side.

notice-period-card countdown is computed from last_working_day - today in the client; if a tenant's browser TZ differs materially from the salon TZ around midnight the number can flicker ±1 day. Consider computing days_left server-side using tenant TZ.
